player_prompt.intro:
Wena uyisitiyela {player_id}. Unemdlalo we-15-Puzzle.
Inkhululeko yemdlalo kukuhlanganisa tikhadi tetifanele kuwe kuya ngemuva kuya ku-15, kanye netisipho esikhundleni sakhe sesidla esingemuva kwesokunene.
Ukwenza khambo, ungakwazi ukuphinda khambo esiphakeme kwesitsho (esichaziwa ngemaphethelo ambalwa, e.g. __) ngokusebenzisa amalungelo afananayo:
- 'up': Phinda khambo laphakeme kwesitsho phambili.
- 'down': Phinda khambo laphansi kwesitsho phansi.
- 'left': Phinda khambo kwesokudla kwesitsho kwesokudla.
- 'right': Phinda khambo kwesokunene kwesitsho kwesokunene.
Ukwenza khambo yakho, khombisa ndlela (e.g., 'up', 'down', 'left', or 'right') emaphethelweni, e.g. [up].
Lesitsheni lesimanje sishowelelwa lapha nansi. Sebenzisa ulwazi ukulungisa puzzle.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Umdlali {player_id} akazange aphendvule ngekukhombisa indlela lelungile.
invalid_move.illegal_move: Kuntjintja lokungasebenti. Lamatilosi angeke akhone kuntjintjwa ngendlela lechaziwe.

outcome.win: Sihalalisela! Umdlali {player_id} uphumelele ngekusombulula i-Puzzle le-15 .
outcome.turn_limit: Umkhawulo wekujika sewufinyelelwe. Lomfanekiso ucedze {percent} ngemaphesenti empuzzle
